Best Chatbot AI Tools

11 chatbot AI tools, compared by features, pricing and rating. Open any tool for details and similar alternatives.

AI tools in this category

  • ChatGPT: OpenAI's flagship conversational AI. Write, code, analyze, brainstorm — the most versatile AI assistant.
  • Claude AI: Anthropic's safety-focused AI assistant. Excellent at analysis, writing, and nuanced conversations.
  • Google Gemini: Google's most capable multimodal AI with real-time web access and deep Google integration.
  • Perplexity AI: AI-powered answer engine that searches the web in real-time and provides cited, accurate answers.
  • Microsoft Copilot: Microsoft's AI assistant powered by GPT-4 with Bing search integration and Office 365 support.
  • Character AI: Create and chat with AI characters. Immersive roleplay with customizable AI personalities.
  • Pi AI: Inflection AI's personal AI that focuses on emotional intelligence and supportive conversations.
  • DeepSeek: Capable open-weight reasoning and chat models available free in the browser and via a low-cost API.
  • Grok: xAI's conversational assistant with real-time access to posts on X and a witty personality.
  • Mistral Le Chat: Mistral AI's assistant with fast models, web search, document upload and a strong European privacy angle.
  • Poe: One app to chat with many different AI models and build your own custom bots on top of them.
